name: runbox
description: Save and organize your terminal commands, then run them in one click, with reusable variables, favorites, and AI-powered generation and explanations.

runBox.aiProvider.description: The AI provider to use for generating and explaining terminal commands.

runBox.aiModel.description: The model ID to use for the selected AI provider. Leave empty to use the provider's default model. This is set automatically when you select a model in AI Settings.

runBox.aiGenerateLanguage.description: Language of AI-generated command text: titles, descriptions, and enum value labels. Commands, variable names, enum values, and category/group names are always kept as is. Does not affect command explanations (see runBox.aiExplainLanguage).

runBox.aiExplainLanguage.description: Default language of AI command explanations. Ctrl+click the explain button of a command to pick a different language for a single explanation.

runBox.debugOutput.description: Enable detailed debug output in the VS Code Output Channel (RunBox). Logs internal operations such as AI requests, model listings, and other extension events.

enumDescriptions: On first open, uses the active editor's folder (or the first folder if no editor is active). After the user picks a folder from the dropdown, that choice is remembered across sessions for this workspace.
Always uses the folder of the currently active editor when opening the panel. Falls back to the last remembered selection if no editor is active.
Always uses the first folder in the workspace, regardless of the active editor. The folder selector dropdown is hidden.
runBox.multiRootFolderResolution.description: Controls how the active workspace folder is determined when opening the panel in a multi-root workspace. Has no effect in single-folder workspaces.

runBox.localWorkspaceFilesPath.description: Relative path from the workspace root for extension-local files (variables, favorites, etc.). When empty, files are stored in .vscode/. Example: '.temp' or '.temp/runbox'. Use forward slashes (/) as separators; backslashes also work but are normalized internally so the path resolves correctly on every OS. Changing this setting does not move existing files: you must manually move them to the new path, otherwise new files are created there and the old ones are ignored.

runBox.workspaceID.description: Auto-generated unique identifier for this workspace folder, used to link 'Current Workspace' commands and groups to this specific project. Created automatically the first time you add a group or command under 'Current Workspace'. Do not edit or copy this value manually between projects.
